summary: Gila National Forest lookout in Catron County, NM: first Aermotor MC-24 tower 1933, steel cab 1966, NHLR-registered 2006; staffing and access not found.

facts.design: Aermotor MC-24 tower with a wooden cab; cab replaced in 1966 with a steel CL-100 series cab

events.note: First tower erected as an Aermotor MC-24 with an observation cab; the NHLR Built field gives 1966

Found not eligible in the 1988 thematic National Register review

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR Built field gives 1966; West Lookouts and the 2020 chapter report give 1933 for the first MC-24 tower, and NHLR's description confirms an MC-24 tower with a wooden cab came first. The story uses 1933 for the first tower and 1966 for the cab.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives staffing, current condition or public access, so the story says so and gives no visit advice. The 2013 vandalism item has no detail. The CR report caption credits a photo to Dave Lorenz, but no image URL was read, so no photo added. The older NHLR page (Lookout.aspx?id=685) returned 500 and was not used.
